accessPolicy.note: DrugCentral states that the resource is available under a Creative Commons licence and links to CC BY-SA 4.0. The public download page identifies the current full dump as 11/01/2023 and says it contains all DrugCentral information. DrugCentral aggregates literature, labels, regulatory sources, and external databases, so the database licence does not eliminate item-level provenance, currentness, accuracy, or third-party-rights review. PsychSim treats it as a broad authoring seed rather than primary clinical authority.
